name: Solace
description: The Solace connector enables WSO2 Micro Integrator (MI) to publish messages and interact with Solace PubSub+ brokers. It supports reliable, asynchronous communication, allowing you to send messages to topics or queues, use request/reply patterns, and manage acknowledgments.

params.name: destinationType
params.description: Destination type: TOPIC or QUEUE. Supported values: TOPIC, QUEUE

params.name: destinationName
params.description: Name of the topic or queue to publish to.

params.name: messageType
params.description: Message type: TEXT, BYTES, or XML. JSON payloads are auto-detected and carried as TEXT. Supported values: TEXT, BYTES, XML

params.name: deliveryMode
params.description: Delivery mode. DIRECT is valid only for TOPIC destinations (best-effort pub/sub). QUEUE destinations require PERSISTENT or NON_PERSISTENT (guaranteed delivery). Supported values: DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT

params.name: correlationId
params.description: Optional trace ID echoed by any consumer that replies. Useful for log correlation across services.

params.name: priority
params.description: Message priority (0-255).

params.name: timeToLive
params.description: Time to live in milliseconds.

params.name: applicationMessageId
params.description: Application-defined message ID.

params.name: applicationMessageType
params.description: Application-defined message type.

params.name: replyToDestinationType
params.description: Destination type where consumers should send their reply: TOPIC or QUEUE. Leave blank for fire-and-forget messages. Supported values: TOPIC, QUEUE

params.name: replyToDestinationName
params.description: Pre-existing destination name where replies should arrive. You must run a separate inbound endpoint to consume from it. For synchronous request-reply, use the Send Request operation instead.

params.name: dmqEligible
params.description: Whether the message is eligible for the Dead Message Queue if it cannot be delivered.

params.name: elidingEligible
params.description: Whether the message is eligible for eliding. When enabled, the broker may discard intermediate messages on a topic to reduce load.

params.name: waitForAck
params.description: If true, block for the broker ACK before returning. Ack outcome is exposed via the 'solace.ack.status' property (ACK | NACK | TIMEOUT). Only applies to PERSISTENT and NON_PERSISTENT delivery modes.

params.name: ackTimeout
params.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the broker ACK when Wait For Ack is enabled.

params.name: continueOnAckFailure
params.description: When enabled, a NACK or ACK timeout will not throw. Inspect the 'solace.ack.status' property (ACK | NACK | TIMEOUT) to branch the flow. When disabled (default), failures throw and go to the fault sequence.

params.name: responseVariable
params.description: Property name where the publish result JSON is stored. Contains: destination, destinationType, deliveryMode, messageType, ackStatus, ackReceived, correlationKey, error, publishedAt.

params.name: overwriteBody
params.description: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response of the operation.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the operation.

params.name: responseVariable
params.description: Property name where the operation result is stored.

params.name: overwriteBody
params.description: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response of the operation.

params.name: transactionTimeoutMillis
params.description: Auto-rollback after this many ms if commit/rollback isn't reached. Prevents leaks from forgotten or faulted sequences.

params.name: queueName
params.description: Name of the queue to poll.

params.name: pollTimeout
params.description: Maximum time to wait for a message in milliseconds. Default: 5000.

params.name: selector
params.description: Optional JMS-style selector expression for filtering (e.g., region = 'EU' AND priority > 5). Leave blank to match any message.

params.name: responseVariable
params.description: Property name where the result JSON is stored. Contains: destination, received, timedOut, messageId, correlationId, payload, contentType.

params.name: overwriteBody
params.description: Replace the message body in Message Context with the polled message's payload.

params.name: outcomeType
params.description: FAILED: broker redelivers the message (subject to max-redelivery, then DMQ if configured). REJECTED: broker routes immediately to DMQ, otherwise discards. Inbound endpoint must declare required settlement outcomes for this to work. Supported values: FAILED, REJECTED

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the operation.

params.name: responseVariable
params.description: Property name where the operation result is stored.

params.name: overwriteBody
params.description: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response of the operation.

params.description: Description of the operation.

params.name: responseVariable
params.description: Property name where the operation result is stored.

params.name: overwriteBody
params.description: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response of the operation.

params.name: destinationType
params.description: Destination type: TOPIC or QUEUE. Supported values: TOPIC, QUEUE

params.name: destinationName
params.description: Name of the topic or queue to send the request to.

params.name: messageType
params.description: Message type: TEXT, BYTES, or XML. JSON payloads are auto-detected and carried as TEXT. Supported values: TEXT, BYTES, XML

params.name: requestTimeout
params.description: Maximum time to wait for response in milliseconds (default: 30000).

params.name: deliveryMode
params.description: Delivery mode. DIRECT is valid only for TOPIC destinations (best-effort pub/sub). QUEUE destinations require PERSISTENT or NON_PERSISTENT (guaranteed delivery). Supported values: DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT

params.name: applicationMessageId
params.description: Application-defined message ID.

params.name: applicationMessageType
params.description: Application-defined message type.

params.name: responseVariable
params.description: The name of the variable to which the output should be stored.

params.name: overwriteBody
params.description: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response.

params.name: cacheName
params.description: REQUIRED. Name of the PubSub+ Cache Instance configured on the broker for this VPN. The instance must be deployed, joined to the VPN, and have caching enabled for the requested topic pattern. Verify in PubSub+ Manager: Cluster Manager > Cache Instances.

params.name: topicPattern
params.description: REQUIRED. Topic name or wildcard pattern to retrieve cached messages for (e.g., stock/AAPL or stock/>). The cache instance must already be subscribed to this pattern administratively — clients cannot create cache subscriptions on the fly.

params.name: cacheMaxMessages
params.description: Maximum cached messages to request. 0 means unlimited (subject to broker-side cache instance limits).

params.name: cacheMaxAgeSeconds
params.description: Maximum age of cached messages to return, in seconds. 0 means any age.

params.name: cacheRequestTimeout
params.description: Maximum time the cache request itself may take in milliseconds. Default: 10000.

params.name: liveDataAction
params.description: How live messages on the same topic interleave with cached delivery. FULFILL: cached messages first, then live (recommended for cold start). FLOW_THRU: interleave (lowest latency for live). QUEUE: queue live messages until cache delivery completes. Supported values: FULFILL, FLOW_THRU, QUEUE

params.name: responseVariable
params.description: Property name where the result JSON is stored. Contains: cacheName, topicPattern, messageCount, messages (array of cached message summaries with payload + headers).

params.name: overwriteBody
params.description: Unused for cache request — messages are returned via the response variable.

params.name: queueName
params.description: Name of the queue to browse.

params.name: maxMessages
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Default: 10.

params.name: browseTimeout
params.description: Maximum time to wait per message read in milliseconds. Browse stops once no message arrives within this window. Default: 2000.

params.name: selector
params.description: Optional JMS-style selector expression for filtering (e.g., region = 'EU' AND priority > 5). Leave blank to match any message.

params.name: responseVariable
params.description: Property name where the result JSON is stored. Contains: destination, messageCount, messages (array of message summaries with payload + headers).

params.name: overwriteBody
params.description: Unused for browse — messages are returned via the response variable.

params.name: connectionName
params.description: The name for the Solace connection.

params.name: host
params.description: The host URL for the Solace broker (e.g., tcp://localhost:55555 or tcps://broker.example.com:55443 for SSL).

params.name: vpnName
params.description: Message VPN name.

params.name: authenticationScheme
params.description: How the broker authenticates this connection. BASIC uses username/password (default). CLIENT_CERTIFICATE uses the configured key store as the credential — broker derives the username from the cert CN. OAUTH2 uses an access token (and optionally an OIDC ID token / issuer identifier). Supported values: BASIC, CLIENT_CERTIFICATE, OAUTH2

params.name: username
params.description: The username for authenticating with the Solace broker.

params.name: apiProvidedUsername
params.description: Optional. Used only when the Message VPN is configured with 'allow-api-provided-username'. For CLIENT_CERTIFICATE auth, leave blank to use the certificate's Common Name (default broker behavior). For OAUTH2, leave blank — identity comes from the token.

params.name: password
params.description: The password for authenticating with the Solace broker.

params.name: oauth2AccessToken
params.description: OAuth2 access token used to authenticate with the broker. Provide either this, an OIDC ID token, or both. The broker validates the token against its configured OAuth profile.

params.name: oidcIdToken
params.description: Optional OIDC ID token. Used in the OAuth client-role profile. Provide either this, an access token, or both.

params.name: oauth2IssuerIdentifier
params.description: Optional issuer URI used to disambiguate when the broker has multiple OAuth profiles and the issuer can't be derived from the token. Leave blank for single-profile setups.

params.name: clientName
params.description: Unique client name for the session (auto-generated if not provided).

params.name: connectionTimeout
params.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds.

params.name: readTimeout
params.description: Read timeout in milliseconds.

params.name: connectRetries
params.description: Number of connection retry attempts.

params.name: connectRetriesPerHost
params.description: Number of connection retries per host.

params.name: reconnectRetries
params.description: Number of reconnection retry attempts.

params.name: reconnectRetryWait
params.description: Wait time between reconnection retries in milliseconds.

params.name: compressionLevel
params.description: Compression level (0-9). 0 disables compression.

params.name: sslTrustStorePath
params.description: Path to the SSL trust store file containing CA certificates for broker validation.

params.name: sslTrustStorePassword
params.description: Password for the SSL trust store.

params.name: sslTrustStoreFormat
params.description: Format of the SSL trust store (e.g., JKS, PKCS12).

params.name: sslKeyStorePath
params.description: Path to the SSL key store file containing client certificates for mutual TLS.

params.name: sslKeyStorePassword
params.description: Password for the SSL key store.

params.name: sslKeyStoreFormat
params.description: Format of the SSL key store (e.g., JKS, PKCS12).

params.name: sslKeyPassword
params.description: Password for the SSL private key.

params.name: sslValidateCertificate
params.description: Whether to validate the broker's TLS certificate against the trust store. Keep this enabled. Disabling it turns off certificate verification and exposes the connection to man-in-the-middle attacks — not recommended for production.

params.name: sslValidateCertificateDate
params.description: Whether to validate the certificate expiration date. Keep this enabled; disabling it allows expired certificates and is not recommended for production.

params.name: sslValidateHostname
params.description: Whether to verify that the broker's certificate matches the host being connected to. Keep this enabled. Disabling it allows a valid certificate issued for a different host to be accepted, defeating man-in-the-middle protection — not recommended for production.

params.name: generateSendTimestamps
params.description: Whether to automatically generate send timestamps on messages.

params.name: generateSequenceNumbers
params.description: Whether to automatically generate sequence numbers on messages.

params.name: calculateMessageExpiration
params.description: Whether to calculate message expiration based on TTL.
